simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲרִידַי (H742) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֲרִידַי (ʼĂrîyday) means Aridai , a son of Haman First listed occurrence: Esth 9 9.

definitions.full: H742. Ariday אֲרִידַי proper name, masculine a son of Haman Est 9:9 (Persian, perhaps = haridayas, delight of Hari , see Add Thes 72 ; but text very uncertain; compare different tradition as to the names in ᵐ5 ).
